in_hebrew.name: Ardath
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Mountain of the Gods
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Ardath הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Ardath is a Persian name derived from the Old Persian word ‘Arda’ meaning mountain or high place, and ‘Daeva’ meaning gods. In Persian mythology, Ardath was a goddess of fertility and motherhood. In Christianity, Ardath may symbolize the mountain of God, symbolizing the spiritual journey towards enlightenment and divine connection.
